verdict.rationale: The product documents a Codex SDK for automating coding tasks, including CI jobs, which gives a programmatic way to drive part of the product. However, nothing in the evidence documents a public API for driving ChatGPT as a whole, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: documented public API reference covering ChatGPT (not just Codex), an OpenAPI/schema spec, endpoint and auth documentation, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Use the Codex SDK to automate coding tasks, including jobs in CI.
